entities.name: Disa
entities.description: A human Kjeldoran explorer, scout and writer during the Ice Age, wife of Kolbjörn and adoptive mother of Kaysa.

entities.name: Kolbjörn
entities.description: Elder Druid married to Disa who comes to take Kaysa to Fyndhorn.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: Child bearing the mark of the Elder Druid, ward of Halvor and adoptive daughter of Disa.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer who attacked Kjeldor and commands undead legions.

entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
entities.description: Knight who guarded a mountain pass and later fought the undead.

entities.name: Klazina Jansdotter
entities.description: Knight who guarded a mountain pass and later fought the undead.

entities.name: Halvor Arenson
entities.description: Priest of the church at Mikkel who creates a disk of sunlight to destroy the dead.

entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: Knight of the Order of Stromgald who allied with Lim-Dûl and became undead.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Goddess whose song strips the undead of their life.

entities.name: Mikkel
entities.description: Village where the group seeks refuge; its villagers become undead.

entities.name: Fyndhorn
entities.description: Forest where Kolbjörn lives among the elves.

entities.name: Lhurgoyfs
entities.description: Creatures that Disa learned to tame and use as guides and guardians.

entities.name: Order of Stromgald
entities.description: Order of knights of which Avram Garrisson was a member.

entities.name: Feast of Kjeld
entities.description: Celebration held in the church at Mikkel.

events.summary: Ten years after Lim-Dûl's first attacks, Disa leads an expedition west seeking allies against the necromancer, reaching a huge wall of ice and finding no one to help Kjeldor.
events.quote: Disa led an expedition into the west in the hope of finding allies to fight together against the necromancer.

events.summary: Disa, Lucilde and Klazina take refuge from a storm at the village of Mikkel and find the church occupied by Halvor and Kaysa.
events.quote: the three reached the village church, where the priest Halvor Arenson and his protegee Kaysa were the only attendants

events.summary: Kolbjörn arrives to take Kaysa to Fyndhorn; Halvor objects, but Kolbjörn says the undead villagers will kill Halvor.
events.quote: When Kolbjörn announced that he had come to take Kaysa

events.summary: Avram Garrisson arrives and reveals he allied himself with Lim-Dul and became undead.
events.quote: Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul, becoming undead

events.summary: The undead villagers break into the church; Kolbjörn and Kaysa chant the song of Freyalise, stripping the undead of life.
events.quote: With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group.

events.summary: Kaysa goes with Kolbjörn to Fyndhorn with Halvor's consent, and Disa travels with them.
events.quote: Disa would travel with Kolbjörn and Kaysa to Fyndhorn.

events.summary: Disa defeats and tames a lhurgoyf that ambushed her party, learning to tame others as guides.
events.quote: Disa faced it head-on and, after a grueling fight, managed to defeat and subdue it

events.summary: Disa dies in the plagues that ravaged Terisiare during the Flood Age.
events.quote: Disa was one of the victims of the plagues that ravaged Terisiare during the Flood Age

relations.quote: She was married to the Elder Druid Kolbjörn
was the adoptive mother of Kaysa
Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul
a knight of the Order of Stromgald
